headline: Antonelli's crowning weekend opens with a virus, Google ships a cyber-defence Gemini, and GTA 6 review codes are out three weeks before launch.

upcoming.what: F1 Mexico City GP: FP1 Fri 18:30, FP2 22:00; quali Sat 21:00; race Sun 1 Nov 20:00 Irish time. Antonelli clinches with a top-nine finish
UFC Fight Night: Moicano vs Nolan, Las Vegas. Prelims 21:00, main card midnight Irish time
IBJJF No-Gi Europeans, Rome: adult black-belt divisions and absolutes
Final ISS spacewalk to finish the solar array upgrade
WEC season finale, 6 Hours of Monza
Football Manager 27 releases (PC, PS5, Xbox, mobile)
UFC 334, New York: Gane vs Hokit for the heavyweight title (main card early Sun 15 Nov Irish time)

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon, a model for cyber defenders
items.summary: The security-focused model arrives two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon, but only vetted defenders get access for now, through a programme called Fairwind. Google says it is going through voluntary US government testing before a wider release.

items.headline: Alphabet passes $127bn in revenue, but Search ad growth slows
items.summary: Quarterly revenue rose 25%, while Search advertising growth slowed to 12%. Google is responding by bringing ads in AI Search to more countries.

items.headline: GitHub says AI agents opened 40% of pull requests in September
items.summary: At GitHub Universe the company launched Copilot Fusion, which routes coding agents across models. Its Octoverse report says agents' share of pull requests has more than doubled since March.

items.headline: Networking: PsiQuantum's first product is an optical switch for AI data centres
items.summary: The 8x8 optical switch prototype came out of its quantum research and routes light between AI processors. Samples are now going to potential customers. Separately, Malaysian customs seized over $12m of AI chips hidden inside 30 servers.

items.headline: Spacewalkers unfurl the seventh new ISS solar array
items.summary: Anil Menon and Joshua Kutryk installed the seventh of eight upgraded iROSA panels. One more spacewalk, on 5 November, will finish the upgrade, which keeps the station powered through to its planned 2030 retirement.

items.headline: ULA targets mid-November return to flight for Vulcan
items.summary: It will be Vulcan's first flight since a booster nozzle failed mid-flight. The rocket will carry 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites.

items.headline: Dwarf-planet crash leaves a 1,000 AU 'cat's tail' at Beta Pictoris
items.summary: Researchers say an odd, stretched-out dust feature around the young star 63 light years away most likely came from two dwarf planets colliding.

items.headline: GTA 6 review codes are out, with reviews reportedly due 18 November
items.summary: Rockstar has reportedly sent review copies to outlets just over three weeks before the 19 November launch. The copies are said to carry watermarks unique to each reviewer to deter leaks.

items.headline: Watchlist: quiet day
items.summary: There was nothing new in the last 48 hours on The Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3's Songs of the Past expansion or Borderlands 4. CDPR's most recent post was a nod to BioWare on The Witcher's 19th birthday.

items.headline: No-Gi Euros reach the black-belt weekend
items.summary: Colour belts and masters have been competing in Rome all week, and the adult black-belt brackets and absolutes run Saturday and Sunday. Results weren't available to verify this morning; full coverage comes after the weekend.

items.headline: Moicano vs Nolan card is set for Halloween night
items.summary: Moicano (#12) faces Tom Nolan (#14) at lightweight, with Yana Santos vs Luana Santos, Randy Brown vs Jacobe Smith and Ode' Osbourne vs Cody Durden also on the main card. That card starts at midnight Irish time, later than the ~23:00 listed yesterday, with prelims from 21:00.

items.headline: Antonelli sick and misses Mexico media day
items.summary: Mercedes says the championship leader has a viral illness and should be back for Friday practice. A top-nine finish on Sunday still makes him F1's youngest ever champion.

items.headline: Bottas also unwell as rumours grow about his Cadillac seat
items.summary: Cadillac called his absence from media day precautionary and said it won't affect his weekend. Pérez's contract extension made no mention of Bottas, and Ocon and Lawson are rumoured to be in the frame for his seat.

items.headline: Ten rookies take part in FP1
items.summary: Every team runs a young driver in first practice: Vesti replaces Russell, Iwasa replaces Verstappen, Fornaroli replaces Norris and Freddie Slater replaces Bortoleto. Colton Herta takes Bottas's Cadillac.
